0022600085.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Orlando Magic hosting the Atlanta Hawks in a regular-season game. The Magic are missing Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring), while the Hawks are without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). In the 2025-26 season series, the Magic lost 0-4 to the Hawks, most recently falling 130-101 in Orlando on April 1, 2026.
